title.orig: Figure Reading at a Table in an Interior at Night
title.en: Figure Reading at a Table in an Interior at Night
title.zh: 夜间室内伏案阅读的人

medium.zh: 黑色与红色粉笔（人工粉笔）

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1916. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1916 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A chalk drawing of a dark room at night. A shaded lamp hangs low over a round table and throws a warm red-orange pool of light across it; the reader named in the title can only just be made out in the gloom.
alt.zh: 一幅描绘夜间暗室的粉笔素描。一盏带罩的灯低悬在圆桌上方，在桌面投下一汪温暖的橙红色光；题目里那位读者，在昏暗中只能勉强辨认。

note.en: An early drawing, made about a decade before the Strandgade rooms. Almost the whole sheet is rubbed dark, and the only colour is red chalk where the lamplight falls. It is a whole evening on one small sheet: a lamp, a table, a reader.
note.zh: 这是一幅早期素描，比斯特兰德街那些房间早了约十年。整张纸几乎都被擦暗，唯一的颜色是灯光落下处的红色粉笔。一张小纸上就是一整个夜晚：一盏灯，一张桌子，一个读者。
